summary: Genasys Inc. filed an 8-K reporting entry into a Loan Agreement with Maran Partners Fund, LP on June 9, 2026. The lender extended an unsecured term loan of $4.3 million at an 18% fixed interest rate, with monthly interest payments and principal due September 14, 2026. An origination fee of $301,000 was deducted, and exit fees range from $64,500 to $150,500. Proceeds are for working capital and general corporate purposes. The agreement includes customary covenants, mandatory prepayment triggers (change of control, asset sales, equity issuances), and a 5% default rate. No board recommendation or advisors named. The loan is a straightforward debt financing, not a special situation. Watch for potential dilution if equity issuances occur or change of control.
